text: The purpose of this report is to appoint a qualified person to the office of Councillor, Ward 1, Etobicoke North.

City Council on June 24, 2022, appointed Rosemarie Bryan to the Office of Councillor, Ward 1, Etobicoke North, for the remainder of this term of Council. City Council also appointed Rosemarie Bryan to the following, effective June 24, 2022: a. the Audit Committee for a term of office until November 14, 2022 and until a successor is appointed; and b. the Economic and Community Development Committee for a term of office until November 14, 2022 and until a successor is appointed.
